digest.component_or_area: Plan Review - AC Satisfiability & Child-Coverage Audit
propositions: Plan review certifies parent tickets and children with zero findings despite mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across them, surfacing contradictions only mid-implementation or at verification gates.

No existing plan-review criterion owns the concern of whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations can hold jointly satisfiable, leaving set-quantification contradictions undetected in Pass-1.
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because it is handed a roster carrying child ids and titles only, lacking the acceptance-criteria items needed to test whether sibling criteria cover parent ACs.

The sibling roster is independently rebuilt in three non-test locations (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), risking divergence between production and eval harnesses that would corrupt dogfooding data for G3's deferred posture decision.
The roster must be moved into the stable system-prompt prefix and its token cost included in parent_tokens prefix estimate to avoid re-sending the entire child AC corpus once per pairing.
